data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 更衣室柜门后的无声缠绵
data.description: 体育馆幽暗的更衣柜狭缝中，水手裙被径直掀起堆叠在小腹。为了不被外面的巡查人员发现，白羽死死捂住自己的嘴唇，在猛烈的侵入下眼角渗出了甜腻的泪水。
data.location: shadowed narrow space between tall steel school lockers in an empty gym
data.action: 为了不被外面的巡查人员发现，白羽死死捂住自己的嘴唇，在猛烈的侵入下眼角渗出了甜腻的泪水
data.lighting: slanted dusty sunbeams through high transom windows highlighting tear tracks on flushed cheeks
data.promptProse: Pressed into the shadowed corner between tall steel lockers in an empty school gym locker room, Shiroha has her navy pleated sailor skirt lifted high above her waist while her partner takes her from behind. Clamping one hand tightly over her own mouth to muffle every gasp lest anyone pass outside, she trembles against the metal locker with flushed cheeks and tear-rimmed eyes. Slanted afternoon sunbeams from high transom windows catch fine dust and the tear tracks along her cheek.
data.animaCaption: Pressed between steel gym lockers with her navy sailor skirt lifted and panties pushed aside, Shiroha clamps a hand over her mouth to stifle gasps as her partner takes her from behind, tears spilling down her flushed cheeks. Slanted afternoon sunbeams cut across the dim alcove.
data.nsfwProse: Her navy pleated sailor skirt is lifted up over her waist and her panties are pulled aside as her partner thrusts into her from behind against the narrow locker-room wall.
